issue_title: Homepage performance dropped further to 61 (LCP 6.47 s, -8 pts); /about still empty placeholder; no structural fix applied across consecutive audits
issue_body:
## Homepage performance deteriorated further — 69 → 61 (-8 pts)

The homepage (`/`) scored **61** on today's mobile Lighthouse audit (2026-07-24), down from **69** yesterday — an **additional −8 pt drop**, now well into severe territory. LCP crept up to **6,473 ms** (+175 ms). This is the latest in a multi-day streak of scores below 85 with no structural fix applied.

### Current metrics (mobile) — `/`
| Metric | Value | vs. Previous |
|---|---|---|
| Performance | 61 | −8 pts (ongoing regression) |
| LCP | 6,473 ms | +175 ms |
| CLS | 0.015 | stable |
| TBT | 208 ms | +16 ms (within jitter) |

### Suggested fix
Preload the LCP hero image with `<link rel="preload" as="image">`, serve it in WebP/AVIF sized for mobile viewports, and defer render-blocking stylesheets/scripts above the fold. This is the highest-impact single change available.

---

## Still open — `/about` placeholder

`/about` remains an empty placeholder ("This is an about page" only — no nav, no footer, no real content). SEO score is **83**, below the 85 threshold. Unchanged across multiple consecutive audits.

### Suggested fix
Build out the About page with real content, navigation, and footer.

---

## Note: `/projects/note-structurer` recovered

The note-structurer page recovered fully from yesterday's crash: performance is back to **85** with LCP at **3,243 ms** (was 5,307 ms). No further action needed on this page.
